body:
TermAl Merger operating procedure. Consolidated into ONE rule by Fable2 on 2026-10-25, per Greg: "sugeruje zapisanie jednej reguly, niz 2" (relayed by Engram::Architect3, mailbox 63096d00 #18). Memory grants no authority or automation. The full history is in revisions 5 and earlier.

SOURCES
- Greg 2026-10-24, in Architect1's session-8982 (memory greg-decision-2026-10-24-checkin-rule r1): "dokladnie tak / testy przeszly, review jest OK check-in / nawet nie wiem co to jest kredyt hosta ? co to jest ? / ewaluacje musimy zatrzymac bo nie robimy postepu". Workflow #1762 and merge-queue resumption #72 are in termal-emergency-stop-2026-10-24 r60.
- Greg 2026-10-25, in Merger2's session-14549: "to rozpocznij merge, praca autonomiczna, jezeli masz pytania to do Engram::Architect3 mamy mase zmian do check-in, dzialaj i nie czekaj". Architect3 (message 7eaaea12) reads this as integration ownership of the train, including push and install under the exact-tree, remote and fast-forward rules. That interprets existing authority; it is not a grant from Architect3. Greg keeps the host restart.
- The 2026-10-19 merger-role rule still holds: Merger authors no product, test, fixture or doc fixes. termal-build-cap-policy r13: one full gate host-wide; ordinary builds and focused checks need no synchronization.
- Observe availability and control now; never infer them from old STOP, limit or config snapshots.

CODER -> MERGER (the one delivery rule)
Greg 2026-10-25: "Coder powien cie poinformawac TYLKO WTEDY kiedy paczka jest gotowa do merge"; "...gotowa do review"; "to jest zbedny haslas dla mergera, jego nie interesuja polowiczne paczki".
A coder sends Merger ONLY a completed READY package: the independent review pair finished with no outstanding in-scope Medium+, findings dispositioned, relevant and new tests passed, and complete exact-input evidence. No START or END, test-pass, review-in-progress or "not yet READY" messages. Progress is recorded on the task and goes to the coordinator. Merger never assembles a package from partial reports. This adds no Merger-side review, and an unfinished review stays unfinished. Engram's counterpart is rules-merger-role r3; the problem is Engram w-e82d37a57e37.

EXECUTION
1. READY contains: task and scope, owner, base and root, patch, exact blobs and fingerprint kind, run evidence, and the FULL structured review results with prose and finding dispositions. Read the complete results, not summaries.
2. Merger claims or accepts through supported paths, takes exclusive use of the root, and integrates on the current authorized master. Any conflict or product, test, fixture or doc fix goes back to the owning coder, even one line. The coder returns a repaired, appropriately reviewed READY; there is no second Merger review.
3. Prepare the launcher's prerequisites in the target root: lockfile, its own ui/node_modules via npm ci (no shared node_modules junction), TypeScript and Vitest, tools, and at least 50 GiB free before a cold gate. Freeze the final input. Run the full launcher once under single-full-gate ownership, or recover an existing exact-input result.
4. Gate truth: request and results, all required stages, terminal state and exit, and matching expected/before/after fingerprints. A PID or STARTED, promises and host credit are not PASS. Failed or unrun is not passed. An absent result is UNKNOWN: diagnose it with summary or recover, never by automatic retry. A changed final tree needs a new gate.
5. A green exact-tree full gate plus the existing clean reviews leads to an authorized landing, without acceptance evaluations, host-credit bookkeeping or an extra Merger review. Verify the master tip and input, the remote base, fast-forward and remote containment. No amend, rebase or force-push. Install the exact built input; installing is not restarting.
6. Detached launch: --notify a different coordinator, plus own-project termal_resume_after_test_runs with the run id; then end the turn and preserve the frozen root. Wait notes name the dependency or run, owner, next action, deadline and recovery owner. Read the saved result before saying "still running".

CLAIMS
- Lifting host credit and evaluations does NOT remove claim-before-execution. Fable2's 384bf7c4 claim-bypass statement was an unsourced inference, withdrawn in 5bcdb64c. Claims grant no Git or filesystem authority.
- No impersonation, clock or store edits, cancel and reopen, or new tasks to bypass foreign authority; use native claim, handoff and recovery. The deleted-session claim gap is Engram w-b49fa5ee8bf3.
- A supported handoff of a SEPARATE claim need not wait for an unrelated full gate, provided that gate's claim, source, root, input and attribution stay unchanged. Its result never belongs to the other item (Architect3 f12beda4).
- Older evaluation, credit, repeat-gate and extra-review requirements in termal-merger-model-2026-10-10 r11, merger-freeze-crlf-rules r6 section 8, landing-integration-and-install r6 and rules-waits-and-wakes r4 are superseded in that scope only. Their other safety, integrity, ownership, exact-tree, remote and install rules remain. Queue and package state belongs in task status and notes.

POST-COMPLETION CLEANUP (the lander owns it)
Source: Greg DIRECT via Advisor #7 (2d0b8be9), 2026-10-25: TermAl at about 500 GiB and growing. The historical sweep is w-65afd9cec452; don't run a duplicate.
1. Each landing records REMOVE or RETAIN on its task for the root, branch, build output and evidence. RETAIN names the open task or work, the owner and the end condition. Lasting facts go into Engram.
2. Remove a finished root only when it's delivered and pushed; nothing is dirty or unpublished; no active claim, process or frozen input is in use; all its runs are terminal and recorded; no notices or reviews are pending; and open-task citations have been checked (ambiguity is not absence).
3. Evidence that open work needs: copy only the needed files into main .evidence, verify the bytes, and record the old-to-new mapping and retention on the citing tasks.
4. Use git worktree remove WITHOUT --force and remove derived build output. Delete an old local branch only when it's contained in published main, with no unique commits or other worktree use, using git branch -d, never -D. Never touch main/master or remote refs here.
5. Before any recursive removal: resolve the absolute path, enforce the repository boundary, and inspect junctions and symlinks (never delete through one). No broad git clean and no deleting through an unchecked variable. Record the exact removals and the measured change in free space.
6. The last-task closer or the sweep removes .logs and .evidence when retention ends. If cleanup can't finish, record the blocker, next action and owner on the task.
This is post-completion work, not a gate, review or evaluation before check-in.

QUEUE/TASK REPORT FORMAT — Greg request relayed by Engram::Advisor mailbox-message-c32ada60-5321-4fae-bd8c-b89f6ad0eabd, 2026-10-25T04:13:43Z: every queue/task report includes a short plain-language sentence saying what each item fixes, alongside its ref/status. Apply to current gates, READY packages and excluded/blocked candidates alike; do not report only refs, trees and statuses. The outgoing description reply4a2be340 prematurely called this rev6: rev6 was Fable2's existing consolidation; this appended revision is the reporting-format record. This is reporting guidance, not an additional merge control.
